properties.statement: Improve parking-control discoverability and provide unambiguous parking-status feedback.

acceptance_criteria.description: In a usability study, customers can identify the parking control and correctly interpret parking status without assistance. The numerical threshold is a proposed target for review.
test_conditions: Recruit prospective customers from the target market.

properties.prioritization_rationale: Review usability value alongside evidence breadth, target-market relevance, existing features, and competing needs. No automatic ranking has been assigned.

limitations: No sample representativeness or future preference validation.
